about_the_game:
THE DEMO

Step into the ultimate sushi restaurant simulator where your creativity and business savvy collide. Own, manage, and grow your very own sushi restaurant, but things aren’t always as simple as they seem. On the grand opening day, everything goes wrong. A catastrophic event threatens to ruin your business before it even begins—can you save it?

In this demo, you'll get to experience the grand opening of the restaurant. The challenge awaits you on the very first day, but not to worry, because Yami chan will try her best to help!

What's included:

  • First Chapter - The Grand Opening

  • Fulfill the first and second sushi orders.

  • Serve some sushi with Yami chan's help!

Add to wishlist now to follow the dev log of the game!

content_descriptors.notes: As this game is a nyotaimori (body sushi) simulation game, some nudity will be depicted. However, there is a streamer mode in the game, off by default. If turned on, all characters wear proper clothing under all circumstances to make sure it's safe for general streaming purposes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 360 (2GB VRAM or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 or AMD RX 580 (4GB VRAM or better)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card with surround sound support

short_description: A casual sushi restaurant simulator, but with waifus.
